what: Edge cases claim a two-column inventory row has exactly two pipe boundary characters
scenario_or_breakage: A 2-column Markdown table row needs three pipes (`| cell1 | cell2 |`); following two-pipe guidance can drop the closing delimiter and break the Makefile Targets table
suggested_fix: Reword to require the same three-pipe, single-line shape as sibling rows (leading, column delimiter, trailing)
